svg.title: Mood across one authored day — synthetic replay, not a lamp recording

cc:Work.dc:title: Mood across one authored day — synthetic replay, not a lamp recording
cc:Work.dc:description: Three bounded scalar curves from 1441 minute samples across 24 authored hours; shaded regions mark sampled sleep. No real lamp or personal data.
